architecture: 8 unchanged CircuitControlEnv observations; two same-width Tanh hidden layers; one linear output; clamp continuous deployment request to [0, 1] for inference
optimizer: CUDA Adam (standard defaults except learning rate, capturable state), float32 full-batch MSE on raw output, no shuffling or data transforms
selection: One fit per seed and width, final epoch only. No held-out labels, scenario parameters, selection, or tuning in fit. No terminal guard, query of a new expert, or online corrective actions.
interpretation: Common whole-scenario splits, closed-loop physics at both grids. Compare paired widths only after physical feasibility and report numerical failures. The high-drag archived teacher may be audited only as a post-fit reference. The two intermediate conditions have no model-aware label. Prior PPO used nominal-only training, so between-method outcomes are descriptive.
